title: From the Mouth of the Guru, One Piece at a Time
label: ch:pa-script-first
canDo: I can add six Gurmukhi pieces to the three learned with ਹਾਂ, then read ਨਹੀਂ and ਨਮਸਤੇ by assembling only known pieces.

payoff.summary: The greeting assembled from five pieces the reader can each write from memory, introducing nothing new, and naming plainly the one piece of machinery still to come.
